checks.name: Bus voltage magnitudes against pandapower
checks.reference: pandapower 3.5.6, runpp (Newton-Raphson, tolerance 1e-8 MVA, reactive limits not enforced) on case1354pegase.m, read by matpowercaseframes, with the phase shift of 6 branches that have a ratio of 0 left out, as ANDES's MATPOWER reader holds them (MATPOWER applies them, and the solution with them differs from this one by at most 6e-05 pu in a bus voltage and 0.087 degrees in a bus angle); written by scripts/crosscheck_pf.py
